review_scope: Inference reproducibility, package consistency and failure accounting; trusted code/runtime required. No security guarantee against malicious code or concurrent file replacement.
guards_reviewed: Externally pinned manifest checksum required by preflight/run CLI
Exact package inventory; source/manifest symlinks and extra bytecode refused
Fresh output directories and dangling symlink refusal
Model/map/input/roster/package identity accounted before success report
known_limits: No Synapse authentication or latest-version lookup
Observed pairs only; no external zero-IBD roster
Frozen feature code accepts out-of-map endpoints, overlaps, fractional physical coordinates and zero-length segments
Package excludes simulation generators and calibration/confirmation segments; no retraining reproduction
